Name: game-mode
Description: The game modes that a level supports.

Name: difficulty
Description: The overall difficulty of completing a level in a casual playthrough. Even minor sections may warrant a higher difficulty.

Name: length
Description: The average time to complete a level in a casual playthrough, without major or unintended skips.

Name: abilities
Description: Which car abilities are enabled, disabled, or toggling throughout a level. Minor sections may not warrant a tag.

Name: gameplay
Description: The core types of gameplay of a level. Minor sections may not warrant a tag.

Name: gimmicks
Description: Additional features of a level that can alter the experience without changing the core gameplay.

Name: readability
Description: How well a level communicates where to go and what to do.

Name: theme
Description: The thematic design and visual style of a level.

Name: wr-difficulty
Description: The overall difficulty of completing a level using the world record route. This is not how hard it is to beat the current world record, and it may exclude the difficulty of optional WR Tech.

Name: wr-length
Description: The time to complete a level using the current world record route.

Name: wr-tech
Description: Advanced or annoying mechanics used in the world record route. The current world record doesn't necessarily use all of them, and they may not be required to be competitive.
